# 0  Shared colour palettes

Defined once here and reused across all figures to stay consistent with the
reference publication palette.

```{r palettes}
# Figure 1 — tenure type bars (light → dark)
pal_tenure <- c(
  "Rental Deserts"            = "#D5C4D6",
  "Mixed-Tenure\nNeighborhoods" = "#9B6B9B",
  "High-Rental\nNeighborhoods"  = "#3D1A5E"
)

# Figures 2 — divergence quartile (light blue → dark purple)
pal_quartile <- c(
  "Least Divergent" = "#DEEAF5",
  "Second Quartile" = "#9ECAE1",
  "Third Quartile"  = "#6A51A3",
  "Most Divergent"  = "#3D0966"
)

# Figure 3 — IRIS divergence type (4 categories + NA)
pal_iris_type <- c(
  "Most Divergent,\nHigh Rental"  = "#08306B",
  "Most Divergent,\nHigh Owner"   = "#54278F",
  "Less Divergent,\nHigh Rental"  = "#9ECAE1",
  "Less Divergent,\nHigh Owner"   = "#BCBDDC"
)

# Figures 4 & 5 — 2×2 segregation type (dark → light)
make_seg_pal <- function(label) {
  setNames(
    c("#4B0082", "#9B6BAB", "#AEC6D8", "#DCE8F4"),
    c(
      paste0("High Housing,\nHigh ", label),
      paste0("High Housing,\nLow ",  label),
      paste0("Low Housing,\nHigh ",  label),
      paste0("Low Housing,\nLow ",   label)
    )
  )
}
pal_seg_income   <- make_seg_pal("Income\nSegregation")
pal_seg_building <- make_seg_pal("Building Age\nSegregation")
```

```{r map-theme}
# Shared ggplot theme for all choropleth maps
theme_map <- function(legend_pos = c(0.14, 0.25)) {
  theme_void() +
    theme(
      legend.position      = legend_pos,
      legend.justification = c(0, 0.5),
      legend.title         = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold",
                                          lineheight = 1.1),
      legend.text          = element_text(size = 7.5),
      legend.key.size      = unit(0.35, "cm"),
      legend.spacing.y     = unit(0.15, "cm"),
      plot.background      = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background     = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.margin          = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
    )
}

# Shared theme for the bar chart
theme_bar <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey88", linetype = "dashed"),
      axis.line.x        = element_line(colour = "grey60", size = 0.3),
      axis.ticks.x       = element_line(colour = "grey60", size = 0.3),
      axis.text          = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.title.x       = element_text(size = 9, margin = margin(t = 6)),
      axis.title.y       = element_blank(),
      legend.position    = "bottom",
      legend.title       = element_blank(),
      legend.text        = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.key.size    = unit(0.4, "cm"),
      legend.spacing.x   = unit(0.3, "cm"),
      plot.background    = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    )
}
```

# 1  Load and prepare data

```{r load-iris}
# ── IRIS point data + rental variables (mirrors France_DiverseIndex.Rmd) ──────
iris_pop <- st_read(path_pop_shp, quiet = TRUE)
france_rental <- read_csv(path_rental_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)

iris_df <- iris_pop %>%
  left_join(france_rental, by = c("CODE_IR" = "IRIS")) %>%
  select(-ends_with(".y")) %>%
  rename_with(~ gsub("\\.x$", "", .)) %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(P21_PMEN, rental_sh, P21_RP, P21_RPMAISON,
             P21_RPAPPART, P21_LOGVAC, P21_LOG,
             P21_RP_ACH19, P21_RP_ACH45, P21_RP_ACH70,
             P21_RP_ACH90, P21_RP_ACH05, P21_RP_ACH18,
             P21_RP_ACHTOT), as.numeric),
    rental_sh = pmax(0, pmin(100, rental_sh)),   # clamp to [0,100]
    owner_sh  = 100 - rental_sh,
    tenure_type = case_when(
      rental_sh <  20 ~ "Rental Deserts",
      rental_sh >= 80 ~ "High-Rental\nNeighborhoods",
      TRUE            ~ "Mixed-Tenure\nNeighborhoods"
    ),
    tenure_type = factor(tenure_type,
      levels = c("Rental Deserts",
                 "Mixed-Tenure\nNeighborhoods",
                 "High-Rental\nNeighborhoods"))
  ) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()
```

```{r compute-divergence}
# ── Top-100 UUs by population ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
top_100_uu <- iris_df %>%
  group_by(UU2020) %>%
  summarise(total_pop = sum(P21_PMEN, na.rm = TRUE),
            lib2020   = first(lib2020), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total_pop)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 100)

# ── Metro-level rental shares ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
metro_shares <- iris_df %>%
  filter(UU2020 %in% top_100_uu$UU2020) %>%
  group_by(UU2020) %>%
  summarise(metro_rental_sh = mean(rental_sh, na.rm = TRUE),
            metro_owner_sh  = 100 - metro_rental_sh, .groups = "drop")

# ── IRIS-level divergence (same formula as France_DiverseIndex.Rmd) ───────────
divergence_values <- iris_df %>%
  filter(UU2020 %in% top_100_uu$UU2020) %>%
  left_join(metro_shares, by = "UU2020") %>%
  mutate(
    divergence_value = rental_sh * log(rental_sh / metro_rental_sh) +
                       owner_sh  * log(owner_sh  / metro_owner_sh)
  )

# ── Metro-level divergence (population-weighted mean) ────────────────────────
metro_divergence <- divergence_values %>%
  group_by(UU2020) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_divergence_value = weighted.mean(divergence_value,
                                         w = P21_PMEN, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    div_quartile = ntile(avg_divergence_value, 4),
    div_category = factor(
      case_when(
        div_quartile == 1 ~ "Least Divergent",
        div_quartile == 2 ~ "Second Quartile",
        div_quartile == 3 ~ "Third Quartile",
        div_quartile == 4 ~ "Most Divergent"
      ),
      levels = c("Least Divergent", "Second Quartile",
                 "Third Quartile",  "Most Divergent")
    )
  )

cat("Metro divergence computed for", nrow(metro_divergence), "urban units\n")
```

```{r compute-income-divergence}
# ── Income divergence (mirrors France_DiverseIndex.Rmd) ──────────────────────
income_raw <- read_csv(path_income_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)

income_iris <- income_raw %>%
  filter(UU2020 %in% top_100_uu$UU2020) %>%
  mutate(income_cat = case_when(
    DEC_MED21 <  20000 ~ "Lower",
    DEC_MED21 <  40000 ~ "Middle",
    !is.na(DEC_MED21)  ~ "Higher",
    TRUE               ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(income_cat))

income_shares <- income_iris %>%
  group_by(UU2020, income_cat) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(UU2020) %>%
  mutate(iris_share = count / sum(count)) %>%
  ungroup()

metro_income_ref <- income_shares %>%
  group_by(income_cat) %>%
  summarise(metro_share = mean(iris_share, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

income_divergence <- income_shares %>%
  left_join(metro_income_ref, by = "income_cat") %>%
  mutate(component = iris_share * log(iris_share / metro_share)) %>%
  group_by(UU2020) %>%
  summarise(income_divergence_index = sum(component, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")
```

```{r compute-building-age}
# ── Building age entropy (mirrors France_DiverseIndex.Rmd) ───────────────────
building_age_divergence <- iris_df %>%
  filter(UU2020 %in% top_100_uu$UU2020) %>%
  mutate(
    s19 = P21_RP_ACH19 / P21_RP_ACHTOT,
    s45 = P21_RP_ACH45 / P21_RP_ACHTOT,
    s70 = P21_RP_ACH70 / P21_RP_ACHTOT,
    s90 = P21_RP_ACH90 / P21_RP_ACHTOT,
    s05 = P21_RP_ACH05 / P21_RP_ACHTOT,
    s18 = P21_RP_ACH18 / P21_RP_ACHTOT
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(bldg_entropy = -sum(
    c(s19, s45, s70, s90, s05, s18) *
    log(c(s19, s45, s70, s90, s05, s18)),
    na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(UU2020) %>%
  summarise(building_age_divergence_index = mean(bldg_entropy, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")
```

# 2  Figure 1 — Average Income Distribution by Tenure Type

**French equivalent of Fig 1**: For each income category (classified by IRIS
median income), shows the share of IRIS falling into each tenure type.
Y-axis mirrors the reference ("Average Share, percent").

```{r}
# Join income category to IRIS data
iris_income <- income_iris %>%
  select(CODE_IR, income_cat, UU2020) %>%
  right_join(
    iris_df %>% select(CODE_IR, tenure_type),
    by = "CODE_IR"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(income_cat))

# For each income_cat × tenure_type: % of IRIS in that tenure type
fig1_data <- iris_income %>%
  group_by(income_cat, tenure_type) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(income_cat) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    income_cat = factor(
      income_cat,
      levels = c("Lower", "Middle", "Higher"),
      labels = c("Less than €20,000",
                 "€20,000–€39,999",
                 "€40,000 or More")
    )
  )
```

```{r}
fig1 <- ggplot(fig1_data,
               aes(x = income_cat, y = pct, fill = tenure_type)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
           width = 0.65, colour = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = pal_tenure,
    labels = c("Rental Deserts",
               "Mixed-Tenure Neighborhoods",
               "High-Rental Neighborhoods")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits   = c(0, 70),
    breaks   = seq(0, 60, 20),
    expand   = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Share of IRIS (Percent)",
    x     = "Household Income (IRIS Median)"
  ) +
  theme_bar() +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1))

fig1
ggsave(paste0(fig_dir, "Figure1_income_tenure.png"),
       fig1, width = 6.5, height = 4, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

# 3  Figure 2 — Housing Tenure Divergence Index Across Urban Units

**French equivalent of Fig 2**: national map of the 100 largest urban units
(UU2020) coloured by divergence index quartile.

```{r}
uu_shp <- st_read(path_uu_shp, quiet = TRUE) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 4326)

# All UUs: grey background; top-100 UUs: coloured by quartile
uu_map_data <- uu_shp %>%
  left_join(
    metro_divergence %>% select(UU2020, div_category),
    by = c("uu2020" = "UU2020")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    fill_var = if_else(!is.na(div_category),
                       as.character(div_category),
                       "Other urban units")
  )

# France bounding box (mainland only)
fr_bbox <- st_bbox(uu_shp)
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
fig2 <- ggplot(uu_map_data) +
  # All non-top-100 UUs: light grey background
  geom_sf(data = filter(uu_map_data, fill_var == "Other urban units"),
          fill = "#EEEEEE", colour = NA) +
  # Top-100 UUs: coloured
  geom_sf(data = filter(uu_map_data, fill_var != "Other urban units"),
          aes(fill = fill_var), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name   = "Divergence Index\nValue (Quartile)",
    values = pal_quartile,
    breaks = names(pal_quartile),
    na.value = "#EEEEEE"
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(fr_bbox["xmin"] - 0.3, fr_bbox["xmax"] + 0.3),
    ylim = c(fr_bbox["ymin"] - 0.3, fr_bbox["ymax"] + 0.3),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_map()

fig2
ggsave(paste0(fig_dir, "Figure2_divergence_national.png"),
       fig2, width = 7.5, height = 5.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

```{r}
# The uu2020 shapefile codes don't match UU2020 in the IRIS data (47/100 match).
# Fix: dissolve IRIS polygon boundaries by u2020_x (= UU2020 in IRIS data)
# to build UU-level geometries that are guaranteed to use the same codes.

if (!exists("iris_poly")) {
  iris_poly <- st_read(path_iris_poly, quiet = TRUE) %>%
    st_transform(crs = 4326)
}

# Dissolve top-100 IRIS to UU-level polygons (takes ~1 min)
uu_polygons <- iris_poly %>%
  filter(u2020_x %in% top_100_uu$UU2020) %>%
  group_by(u2020_x) %>%
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(
    metro_divergence %>% select(UU2020, div_category),
    by = c("u2020_x" = "UU2020")
  ) %>%
  mutate(fill_var = factor(div_category, levels = names(pal_quartile)))

cat("UU polygons built:", nrow(uu_polygons), "\n")
cat("Categories:\n"); print(table(uu_polygons$fill_var, useNA = "ifany"))

# Grey background: all IRIS not in top-100 UUs
iris_bg  <- iris_poly %>% filter(!u2020_x %in% top_100_uu$UU2020)
fr_bbox  <- st_bbox(c(xmin=-5.2, xmax=9.7, ymin=41.2, ymax=51.2), crs=4326)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
fig2 <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = iris_bg,     fill = "#E8E8E8", colour = NA) +
  geom_sf(data = uu_polygons, aes(fill = fill_var),
          colour = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name   = "Divergence Index\nValue (Quartile)",
    values = pal_quartile,
    drop   = FALSE
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(fr_bbox["xmin"], fr_bbox["xmax"]),
           ylim = c(fr_bbox["ymin"], fr_bbox["ymax"]),
           expand = FALSE) +
  theme_map()

fig2
ggsave(paste0(fig_dir, "Figure2_divergence_national.png"),
       fig2, width = 7.5, height = 5.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

# 4  Figure 3 — Neighborhood Divergence Type: `r FIGURE3_CITY`

**French equivalent of Fig 3**: IRIS-level map for one metro, classifying
each IRIS by whether it is Most/Less Divergent and High Rental/High Owner.
Quartiles are computed *within* the selected metro.

```{r}
# Load IRIS polygon boundaries
iris_poly <- st_read(path_iris_poly, quiet = TRUE) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 4326)

# Find the UU2020 code for the selected city
target_uu <- top_100_uu %>%
  filter(str_detect(lib2020, fixed(FIGURE3_CITY, ignore_case = TRUE))) %>%
  pull(UU2020)

if (length(target_uu) == 0) {
  stop("City '", FIGURE3_CITY,
       "' not found in top-100 UUs. Check lib2020 names with: top_100_uu$lib2020")
}
cat("Mapping:", FIGURE3_CITY, "— UU2020 code:", target_uu[1], "\n")

# IRIS divergence for this metro, with within-metro quartile split
iris_city_div <- divergence_values %>%
  filter(UU2020 == target_uu[1]) %>%
  mutate(
    div_quartile = ntile(divergence_value, 4),
    iris_type    = case_when(
      div_quartile == 4 & rental_sh > owner_sh ~
        "Most Divergent,\nHigh Rental",
      div_quartile == 4 & rental_sh <= owner_sh ~
        "Most Divergent,\nHigh Owner",
      div_quartile < 4 & rental_sh > owner_sh ~
        "Less Divergent,\nHigh Rental",
      TRUE ~
        "Less Divergent,\nHigh Owner"
    ),
    iris_type = factor(iris_type, levels = names(pal_iris_type))
  ) %>%
  select(CODE_IR, iris_type)

# Join to polygon geometry
iris_city_map <- iris_poly %>%
  filter(u2020_x == target_uu[1]) %>%
  left_join(iris_city_div, by = "CODE_IR")
```

```{r}
#fig3 <- ggplot(iris_city_map) +
  #geom_sf(aes(fill = iris_type), colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.05) +

fig3 <- ggplot(iris_city_map) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = iris_type), colour = NA, linewidth = 0.05) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name     = "Neighborhood\nDivergence Type",
    values   = pal_iris_type,
    na.value = "#CCCCCC",
    na.translate = TRUE,
    labels   = c(names(pal_iris_type), "NA")
  ) +
  theme_map(legend_pos = c(0.02, 0.2))

fig3
ggsave(paste0(fig_dir, paste0("Figure3_iris_map_", FIGURE3_CITY, ".png")),
       fig3, width = 13, height = 12, dpi = 900, bg = "white")
```

# 5  Figure 4 — Housing Tenure × Building Age Segregation

**French equivalent of Fig 4**: replaces racial segregation (not collected in
France) with building age entropy — a proxy for neighbourhood housing
diversity. Each urban unit is classified by whether it is above or below the
median on both dimensions.

```{r include=FALSE}
# ── Figure 4 data: create seg_bldg first ─────────────────────────────────────

building_threshold <- median(
  building_age_divergence$building_age_divergence_index,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

housing_threshold <- median(
  metro_divergence$avg_divergence_value,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

pal_seg_building <- c(
  "Low Housing, Low Building Age Segregation"   = "#C6CBEF",
  "Low Housing, High Building Age Segregation"  = "#9BAFD4",
  "High Housing, Low Building Age Segregation"  = "#756BB1",
  "High Housing, High Building Age Segregation" = "#54278F"
)

seg_bldg <- metro_divergence %>%
  left_join(building_age_divergence, by = "UU2020") %>%
  mutate(
    seg_type = case_when(
      avg_divergence_value >= housing_threshold &
        building_age_divergence_index >= building_threshold ~
        "High Housing, High Building Age Segregation",
      
      avg_divergence_value >= housing_threshold &
        building_age_divergence_index < building_threshold ~
        "High Housing, Low Building Age Segregation",
      
      avg_divergence_value < housing_threshold &
        building_age_divergence_index >= building_threshold ~
        "Low Housing, High Building Age Segregation",
      
      TRUE ~
        "Low Housing, Low Building Age Segregation"
    ),
    seg_type = factor(seg_type, levels = names(pal_seg_building))
  )

# Filter out rural catchalls from the background and colored layers
# Their lib2020 starts with "Commune hors" — but uu_polygons has no lib2020
# Use the UU2020 codes directly from top_100_uu (already filtered)

uu_background <- uu_polygons %>%
  filter(
    !UU2020 %in% seg_bldg$UU2020,     # not in top-100 coloured
    UU2020 %in% c(                     # keep only named UUs as grey background
      uu_stats$UU2020,                 # all 100 named UUs
      # OR: filter out codes ending in "000" (département catchalls)
    )
  )
```

```{r include=FALSE}
income_threshold <- median(income_divergence$income_divergence_index, na.rm = TRUE)

seg_income <- metro_divergence %>%
  left_join(income_divergence, by = "UU2020") %>%
  mutate(
    seg_type = case_when(
      avg_divergence_value >= housing_threshold &
        income_divergence_index >= income_threshold ~
        "High Housing, High Income Segregation",

      avg_divergence_value >= housing_threshold &
        income_divergence_index < income_threshold ~
        "High Housing, Low Income Segregation",

      avg_divergence_value < housing_threshold &
        income_divergence_index >= income_threshold ~
        "Low Housing, High Income Segregation",

      TRUE ~
        "Low Housing, Low Income Segregation"
    ),
    seg_type = stringr::str_squish(as.character(seg_type)),
    seg_type = factor(seg_type, levels = names(pal_seg_income))
  )
```

```{r}
# figure4-data — replace the uu_bldg_map line:
uu_bldg_map <- uu_polygons %>%
  left_join(seg_bldg %>% select(UU2020, seg_type),
            by = c("u2020_x" = "UU2020"))

# figure5-data — replace the uu_income_map line:
uu_income_map <- uu_polygons %>%
  left_join(seg_income %>% select(UU2020, seg_type),
```

# Notes on French adaptations

| Reference figure | French adaptation | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| Fig 1 — household income brackets ($) | IRIS classified by median income (DEC_MED21): <€20k / €20–40k / ≥€40k | French income data is IRIS-level median, not household counts by bracket |
| Fig 2 — CBSA divergence map | UU2020 divergence map (top 100 by population) | Urban Units are the French CBSA equivalent |
| Fig 3 — single metro IRIS map | Same structure; default city = Paris | Change `FIGURE3_CITY` at top to any lib2020 name |
| Fig 4 — housing × **racial** segregation | Housing × **building age entropy** | France does not collect race/ethnicity in the census; building age entropy is a validated housing diversity proxy used in the existing Rmd |
| Fig 5 — housing × income segregation | Same; income divergence from DEC_MED21 | Direct equivalent |



---

# New Maps
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)

# ── Define the 20 cities ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
top10_names    <- c("Le Havre", "Nîmes", "Tours", "Limoges", "Rouen",
                    "Le Mans", "Lille (partie française)", "Brest",
                    "Marseille-Aix-en-Provence", "Paris")
bottom10_names <- c("Saint-Cyprien", "Menton-Monaco (partie française)",
                    "La Teste-de-Buch-Arcachon", "Armentières (partie française)",
                    "Fréjus", "Annecy", "Bayonne (partie française)",
                    "Maubeuge (partie française)", "Saint-Just-Saint-Rambert",
                    "Sète")

# Get UU2020 codes and group label
selected_uu <- uu_stats %>%
  filter(lib2020 %in% c(top10_names, bottom10_names)) %>%
  mutate(
    group = if_else(lib2020 %in% top10_names,
                    "Top 10 — Most Divergent",
                    "Bottom 10 — Least Divergent"),
    group = factor(group,
                   levels = c("Top 10 — Most Divergent",
                              "Bottom 10 — Least Divergent"))
  ) %>%
  select(UU2020, lib2020, avg_divergence, group)

cat("Cities matched:", nrow(selected_uu), "/ 20\n")
cat("Unmatched:\n")
print(setdiff(c(top10_names, bottom10_names), selected_uu$lib2020))

# ── IRIS divergence categories (within-metro quartile, same as Figure 3) ─────
iris_20 <- divergence_values %>%
  filter(UU2020 %in% selected_uu$UU2020) %>%
  group_by(UU2020) %>%
  mutate(
    div_quartile = ntile(divergence_value, 4),
    iris_type    = case_when(
      div_quartile == 4 & rental_sh > owner_sh ~ "Most Divergent,\nHigh Rental",
      div_quartile == 4 & rental_sh <= owner_sh ~ "Most Divergent,\nHigh Owner",
      div_quartile < 4  & rental_sh > owner_sh ~ "Less Divergent,\nHigh Rental",
      TRUE                                      ~ "Less Divergent,\nHigh Owner"
    ),
    iris_type = factor(iris_type, levels = c(
      "Most Divergent,\nHigh Rental",
      "Most Divergent,\nHigh Owner",
      "Less Divergent,\nHigh Rental",
      "Less Divergent,\nHigh Owner"
    ))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(CODE_IR, UU2020, iris_type)

# ── Join to polygon geometry ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
iris_20_map <- iris_poly %>%
  filter(as.character(u2020_x) %in% selected_uu$UU2020) %>%
  rename(UU2020 = u2020_x) %>%
  mutate(UU2020 = as.character(UU2020)) %>%
  left_join(
    iris_20 %>% st_drop_geometry(),          # ← drop geometry if present
    by = c("CODE_IR", "UU2020")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    selected_uu %>% select(UU2020, lib2020, group, avg_divergence),
    by = "UU2020"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    city_label = paste0(lib2020, "\n(div = ", round(avg_divergence, 2), ")")
  )

# ── Faceted map ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pal_iris <- c(
  "Most Divergent,\nHigh Rental"  = "#08306B",
  "Most Divergent,\nHigh Owner"   = "#54278F",
  "Less Divergent,\nHigh Rental"  = "#9ECAE1",
  "Less Divergent,\nHigh Owner"   = "#BCBDDC"
)

# ── One map per city, saved individually ─────────────────────────────────────
walk(selected_uu$UU2020, function(uu_code) {
  
  city_info <- selected_uu %>% filter(UU2020 == uu_code)
  city_name <- city_info$lib2020
  city_div  <- round(city_info$avg_divergence, 2)
  city_grp  <- city_info$group

  city_map <- iris_20_map %>%
    filter(UU2020 == uu_code) %>%
    # Match category label format from your existing Rmd (no \n)
    mutate(iris_type = recode(as.character(iris_type),
      "Most Divergent,\nHigh Rental"  = "Most Divergent, High-Rental",
      "Most Divergent,\nHigh Owner"   = "Most Divergent, High-Owner",
      "Less Divergent,\nHigh Rental"  = "Less Divergent, High-Rental",
      "Less Divergent,\nHigh Owner"   = "Less Divergent, High-Owner"
    ))

  p <- ggplot(data = city_map) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = iris_type), color = "black", size = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Most Divergent, High-Rental" = "#08519c",
        "Most Divergent, High-Owner"  = "#6a51a3",
        "Less Divergent, High-Rental" = "#9ecae1",
        "Less Divergent, High-Owner"  = "#cbc9e2"
      ),
      na.value = "grey70",
      name     = "Divergence Category"
    ) +
    labs(title = paste0("Divergence Index Map for ", city_name,
                        "  (div = ", city_div, ")")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.title       = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 13)
    )

  safe_name <- city_name %>%
    str_replace_all("[^a-zA-Z0-9]", "_") %>%
    str_replace_all("_+", "_") %>%
    str_remove("_$")

  filename <- paste0(fig_dir, "Figure3_", safe_name, ".png")
  ggsave(filename, p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  cat("Saved:", filename, "\n")
})
```
